features: Supplier payment detail endpoint: Added the show() method in PagamentoFornitoreController with ownership guard, relationships eager loading, and Inertia rendering to the PagamentoShow page.
Size prop on ConfirmDialog: The shared ConfirmDialog.vue component now supports a size prop with four sizes (sm, md, lg, xl) that overrides the default width.
F24 Refactor — SyncF24WithPagamento listener: Created the listener that creates the 'F24 Withholding' task in the Admin Inbox at the time of actual payment, not upon invoice registration.

Supplier payment detail page (PagamentoShow): Created the PagamentoShow.vue Vue page with GestionaleLayout layout, amounts summary, double entry of the linked journal entry, paid invoices, and PDF Statement button.

Detail link in payments list dropdown: Added 'View details' item in DataTableRowActions.vue navigating to PagamentoShow. The previous 'Journal entry details' item is renamed to 'Accounting journal entry details'.
Enlarged Shareholders' meeting ratification — Justified overrun modal: The overrun approval ConfirmDialog now uses size="lg" to give room to the legal text.

Overrun Approval modal wording rewritten (Art. 1135 c.c.): The modal text and tooltip badge have been rewritten to explicitly cover the two scenarios foreseen by Art. 1135 c.c. (expense already resolved or urgent payment by the administrator).
Unified case: Modal titles and texts now follow sentence case instead of title case.
SyncScadenziarioWithFattura — dead code removed: Eliminated the commented block that created the F24 task at invoice time.
Accounting journal entry details menu item appeared disabled: Removed the class causing a gray appearance identical to the disabled state.

PDF Print Settings: Added a new global configuration panel dedicated to prints. It is now possible to define a Legal Note (e.g. profession exercised pursuant to Law 4/2013, VAT number, RC Policy) that will appear as a footer in all generated statements.

Administrator Signature: Implemented the ability to upload the administrator's signature image (in PNG or JPG format), which will be automatically affixed to the bottom of official documents such as reports and installment statements.

Condominium Filter on Admin Action Inbox: Added a dropdown in the top navigation bar of the /admin/inbox page to filter tasks by individual condominium. The KPI cards (Overdue/Urgent, Payment Verifications, Tickets & Maintenance, Total) update dynamically based on the selected condominium.
InfiniteScroll on Admin Action Inbox: Static pagination has been replaced with infinite loading via Inertia::scroll, aligning the behavior with the widget in the property management dashboard.

Critical Bug — Inert 'Resolve' Button: The 'Resolve' button on the admin /admin/inbox page performed no action on tasks without an action_url because the completeTask() function was missing. The completion button is now always visible for all tasks; the 'Resolve →' link appears additionally only if an action_url is present.

Unfiltered KPI Counts: The summary cards always showed global totals even when a specific condominium was selected. The backend now recalculates filtered counts per condominium when the filter is active.

Parent Chapters Dropdown: Fixed a bug in the chart of accounts creation and modification interface where the 'Parent chapter' dropdown did not update instantly after creating a new chapter, forcing the user to reload the page. The component cache now invalidates and synchronizes automatically upon saving.

Owner Allocation Modification to 0%: Fixed a bug in the sub-account modification modal that visually forced the owner's share to 100% upon opening, ignoring the legitimate saving of a 0% share (e.g., for expenses entirely borne by the tenant).

Dynamic Validation Errors Removal: Fixed a usability issue in the account creation and modification modal where red validation errors for the 'Allocation Table' and 'Parent Chapter' fields remained visible even after the user selected a valid value from the dropdown. Errors now disappear in real-time as the selection changes.

Speaking Wire Transfer Reason: Fixed a fatal error during the registration of a payment with speaking wire transfer caused by a call to a non-existent method in the deductions Enum. The fiscal bank reason is now generated correctly and truncated within SEPA limits.
Approval Modal Date Formatting: Fixed a bug in the installment plan approval modal that forced the date selection in American format (yyyy-mm-dd) instead of localized format.

Admin Action Inbox Redesign: Complete layout refactoring of the /admin/inbox page to align with the management system design system. Removed the dark hero header; adopted the standard pattern with label + bold title. The 4 filter cards now follow the style of the admin dashboard KPI cards (decorative background icon, footer with arrow, dynamic colored border). The condominium filter is integrated in the top-bar on the right next to the navigation button.
Task Urgency Ordering: Overdue tasks always appear at the top of the list, followed by future tasks in ascending chronological order, regardless of the active filter.

Action Button Consistency in Inbox: All icon buttons (Complete, Reject) follow the same square visual pattern with border and shadow. Text buttons (Register, Resolve) use the same rectangular container with border and white background.

Installments Plan Details UI/UX Improvements: Optimized the page interface. Action bar buttons now collapse to icons only on laptop screens to prevent horizontal scrolling. Integrated the new uniform header guide with breadcrumbs and moved the deliberation date badge into a convenient interactive tooltip to save vertical space.
